newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end steady.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates held steady on Saturday with a slight dip in overnight calls owing to an uncertainty about borrowing figuers, dealers said.
"The overnight rates dipped to 19 and 19.5 percent as some borrowers had an inflow due to the maturity of their short-term (six-month) federal bonds today," a dealer at KASB & Co said.

He said one-week funds were offered at 20 percent, but buyers remained on the sidelines. There was interest in term repos with three-month offers at 17 percent and bids at 16 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
